reasoning: The icon shows an over-ear headset with a bottom mic boom crossed out by a diagonal slash. While a plain headset or headphones icon is much more common for general audio, gear, or support tasks, this slashed variant specifically fits troubleshooting broken/disconnected headsets, disabling headset audio profiles, or taking phone support offline. At small sizes, the slash and bottom mic boom collide visually, making it slightly harder to parse than a standard headphones-off icon.
